Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de vopsea, straturi de protecție și adezivi
We are looking for an experienced Lead Frontend Architect to drive the architecture and development of scalable, high-performance enterprise web applications.
 Key Responsibilities 
Define and own the frontend architecture strategy
Design scalable, resilient and high-performance UI solutions
Lead development using Next.js , including SSR, routing and middleware
Ensure seamless integration between frontend, backend systems and APIs
Architect solutions involving CDN, DNS, API Gateway and Azure 
Drive best practices around performance, security and UI/UX
Troubleshoot complex issues across frontend, API and infrastructure layers
Provide technical leadership and guidance to engineering teams
 Mandatory Skills 
Strong expertise in Next.js , including SSR, routing and middleware
Strong React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML and CSS 
Experience with GraphQL, Apollo and API integrations 
Strong knowledge of CDN, DNS and edge architectures , such as Akamai or Azure Front Door
Hands-on experience with Azure , including APIM, networking and integration layers
Strong debugging skills across frontend, backend and network layers
 Preferred
Micro-frontend architecture
CI/CD, monitoring and observability
Enterprise CMS platforms such as Contentful or AEM
 Experience 
 12+ years of experience in frontend/full-stack development and architecture
Proven experience designing large-scale enterprise web applications
Strong technical leadership and stakeholder management skills
 What do we offer? 
25 holiday days per year.
1066 RON monthly budget in Benefit Online Platform.
Life Insurance cover.
The employees working on bank holidays will be benefitting either of a paid day off in the next 30 days + 100% of the hourly base salary for that specific day OR 200% of the hourly base salary for that specific day.
Reimbursement for eyeglasses – max 1500 RON to be claimed every 3 years.
Childbirth allowance of 7000 RON after 1 year in HCLTech.
Internal trainings and certifications.
 Who are we? 
 We are HCLTech, one of the fastest-growing large tech companies in the world and home to 225,000+ people across 60 countries, supercharging progress through industry-leading capabilities centered around Digital, Engineering and Cloud. The driving force behind that work, our people, are diverse, creative, and passionate, raising the bar for excellence on a regular basis.
